evidence_items.content: I can use sound data from three locations to decide where our classroom needs a quiet-zone strategy.
Location A: 45 dB. Location B: 61 dB. Location C: 72 dB.

I wanted to find out where our classroom gets too loud. I compared three locations because data is stronger when I compare more than one place. Location C is loudest, which means it may need a schedule change. Next time I would collect data at different times of day.

ai_use_disclosure_text: AI helped me think of graph labels, but I chose the final title and explained the results myself.
